lens: D - Crowdfunding not yet in EU retail
slice: D3 - personal, lifestyle, fashion accessories and beauty-adjacent

ideas.name: Nordic Magnetic Modular Hair Clip System
ideas.concept: A premium magnetic claw/hair clip with swappable decorative caps, sold as a base plus collectible caps; Scandinavian design, tool-less assembly, CNC/stamped metal and cast zinc or brass parts, no steel injection mould.
ideas.target_customer: Women 20-40 in SE/DK buying design-led hair accessories and gifts.
ideas.problem_solved: Claw clips slip, break and look generic; a durable, design-forward clip with repeat-purchase caps.
ideas.trend_evidence: Hair Cliques 2.0 (magnetic hair accessory) funded 101% (USD 14,156, 229 backers, Feb-Mar 2025) per BackerKit; many claw-clip campaigns on Kickstarter; claw-clip comeback cited by an Alibaba seller blog and hair accessories market ~8.7% CAGR (Allied, global). No EU-specific claw-clip sales data verified; crowdfunding totals are small.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered design on the cap interface plus a collectible cap ecosystem and artist collaborations; plain clips are heavily flooded, so only the system is defensible.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stamping/CNC or zinc die-cast (about EUR 300-1,500); avoid steel injection moulds

ideas.name: Ti/Brass EDC Pocket Comb + Hair-Tie Winder
ideas.concept: A CNC-machined metal pocket comb with an integrated elastic/hair-tie winder, anodised or brass, in a minimal Nordic finish and a gift tin; positioned for long-haired men and beard users.
ideas.target_customer: Men and non-binary people with long hair or beards, plus EDC/gift buyers in SE/DK.
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic combs break and lose hair ties; a lifetime-grade pocket tool.
ideas.trend_evidence: A titanium alloy EDC pocket comb + elastic cord winder campaign is listed on PledgeBox (funding figures not verified, page not fetched). Kings Research ties European hair-accessory growth (6.5% CAGR) to male grooming growth.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design and finish, lifetime-engraving personalisation, bundled starter kits; machining is copyable, so brand and bundles carry the moat.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (CNC) apart from fixtures, under EUR 500

ideas.name: Wooden Comb + Refill Care Oil Set
ideas.concept: A hand-finished FSC birch/beech wide-tooth comb in the Japanese-comb tradition with a small refill tin of plant-based wood-conditioning wax, sold as a ritual set with pouch refills.
ideas.target_customer: Design-conscious adults 28-55 who like slow-living and wellness-adjacent objects, no health claims.
ideas.problem_solved: Static and breakage with plastic combs; wood combs dry out and need care, which creates a consumable.
ideas.trend_evidence: A Japanese wood comb campaign ('Beautiful Hair, Timeless Art') is listed on BackerKit; funding results not verified. Evidence of rising demand is weak and unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Refill wax formulation (cosmetic, simple CPNP notification) and gift-set packaging create repeat purchases; the comb alone is easily copied.

ideas.name: Nordic Modular Dice and Pendant Jewelry
ideas.concept: Hypoallergenic stainless steel or brass modular pendants and bracelets with swappable dice/charm modules, themed around Nordic myth and board-game culture; sold as a base plus module packs.
ideas.target_customer: Tabletop gamers and fantasy fans 20-40 in the Nordics, plus gift buyers.
ideas.problem_solved: Gamer jewelry is mostly US Etsy-style and not designed for daily wear or swapping; modules give repeat buying.
ideas.trend_evidence: The Monolith Collection (modular RPG dice jewelry) raised USD 354,591 vs a USD 10,000 goal from 2,047 backers (BackerKit funding date Nov 25, 2025); several other dice-jewelry campaigns exist (DiceDangle II launched Jan 2026). Evidence is for a niche; EU retail availability not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own the Nordic mythology IP and artwork, limited seasonal modules and community of gamers; metalwork is copyable, so IP and community matter.
ideas.tooling_needed: Zinc/brass casting or CNC (EUR 500-1,800); must meet REACH nickel/cadmium/lead limits and need a test report

ideas.name: Clip-On Glare Shade for Prescription Glasses
ideas.concept: A lightweight non-magnetic clip-on sun/glare shade that fits slim optical frames, with Nordic low-sun (winter glare) positioning and a slim case.
ideas.target_customer: Glasses wearers 30-60 in SE/DK who face low-angle winter sun.
ideas.problem_solved: Prescription wearers have to carry a second pair of sunglasses; existing clip-ons are bulky.
ideas.trend_evidence: Sunclip (clip-on attachment) FAILED its Kickstarter, with GBP 2,666 of GBP 40,000, so demand evidence is weak; other eyewear campaigns (Yunizon USD 22,039 of USD 10,000, no year shown) were small. Treat as speculative.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Frame-fit design patent/registered design, plus a fit-finder tool; UV400 certification adds a barrier but also cost and PPE regulation work.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stamped wire/clip tooling (EUR 500-1,500); lens cutting; sunglasses fall under PPE Regulation (CE, UV testing)
